description: Hinweiskarte Starkregengefahren (HWK_SRG) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sgx.geodatenzentrum.de. The warning map Heavy Rain Hazards presents the simulation results for possible heavy rain scenarios. The data contain the maximum flood depth, the maximum flow velocities as well as the flow direction for an exceptional precipitation event (100-yearly), regionally differentiated according to DWD KOSTRA data and an extreme precipitation event (hN = 100 mm/h). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Warning card heavy rain hazards (HWK _SRG)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include BKG, Starkregengefahren, Überflutungstiefen, Fließgeschwindigkeit, Starkregen, Hinweiskarte. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data licence Germany – attribution – Version 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
